text:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — Go SDK v2 docs are live and marked as a breaking release. Migration guide is up: https://docs.redwood.inference/go/v2-migration (please read before upgrading).

Sam: Nice! Is there an auto-migration tool or script?

Elaine: Yes — we added a small CLI helper in tools/go-migrate-sdk. Example: `go run ./cmd/migrate --from v1 --to v2 ./path/to/project`. It rewrites common client initializers and import paths, but manual review is required.

Jess: I pushed redirects so old /go/sdk/* v1 pages redirect to the new v2 equivalents. Canonical examples moved to /go/docs/examples/v2.

Mike: FYI runtime note: default retry behavior changed in v2 (now fails fast on 4xx). Unit tests that assumed automatic retries may break. See CHANGELOG section "Retry semantics".

Phil: Security note: auth header method changed. v1 used `X-Redwood-Api-Key`; v2 expects `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. We need to send a bulletin to Dedicated/Private infra customers because some edge proxies strip custom headers.

doc-bot: PR #512 merged to main (docs + redirect).

Elaine: Deprecation timeline: v1 SDK will receive security fixes only for 90 days from today, then enter "unsupported" mode. Please file migration tickets for any customer blockers.

Sam: Streaming API changed shape — we now return a `Streamer` interface instead of raw channels. Can we add a quick example converting the old pattern?

Elaine: Good call. Added sample conversion in the migration guide and queued a code example PR (assigning @jess to author, @mike to review the runtime implications).

Jess: Assigned reviewers: @mike (runtime), @phil (auth/security wording).

Mike: I'll add a minimal test harness that demonstrates the new retry + streaming interaction.

Elaine: TL;DR: read the migration guide, run the migration helper, check auth header in your infra, and expect a 90-day window for v1. I'll post a short internal FAQ later today. :tada: 

Phil: I'll draft the Dedicated/Private customer advisory and share it in #customer-success for review.

Sam: Thanks — will kick off a migration ticket for one of our integrators who depends on old retry semantics.

Elaine: If anyone spots doc errors or needs an extra example, drop them here or open a docs issue.

doc-bot: changelog: published release notes (v2.0.0) — https://changelog.redwood.inference/releases/go/v2.0.0
